players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: He went 12-of-27 for 144 yards and an INT in the 26-3 TNF loss to Houston on Nov. 19 and was pulled for Anthony Richardson with 7:51 left. Shane Steichen would not commit to him as the Week 12 starter and said the team will 'evaluate everything.'

players.name: C.J. Stroud
players.note: He completed 21 of 27 passes for 194 yards with 3 TDs and 1 INT in the 26-3 TNF win over the Colts on Nov. 19. It was his third straight game with at least three TD passes.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: He missed Wednesday's practice with foot and thumb injuries, then was upgraded to limited on Thursday, Nov. 19, ahead of the game vs. Detroit. If he can't play, Jalon Daniels would start again.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18-19) with a left-ankle injury. He says he plans to play, and the Jets believe he can start Sunday at the Chargers.

players.name: Cade Klubnik
players.note: He would start Sunday at the Chargers only if Geno Smith (ankle) can't play. Smith was limited on Nov. 18-19 and is expected to start.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday (Nov. 18-19) with a hamstring strain and is expected to miss Week 11. Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return vs. Atlanta.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He is set to start Week 11 at San Francisco because Kyler Murray (hamstring) did not practice on Nov. 18-19. Murray is targeting a Week 12 return, so this is a short-term streaming role.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: He was limited in practice on Thursday, Nov. 19, with a back injury and is questionable for Week 11 vs. Kansas City. He is starting with Gardner Minshew on IR, but his fantasy floor is very low.

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.note: He was sick on Thursday, Nov. 19, and skipped his usual media session. The team will reassess him Friday; no official practice designation had been reported yet.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He is out indefinitely with a right-ankle injury from Nov. 15, and as of Nov. 17 the team was still deciding whether he needs surgery after more tests in Germany. Mike Vrabel doesn't expect him back after the Week 11 bye, so Tommy DeVito is set to start.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He missed Week 10 with quad and rib injuries. Seattle is on bye in Week 11, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: He would keep starting for Seattle in Week 12 if Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is still out after the Week 11 bye. He threw for 240 yards and 2 TDs in Week 10.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR, after throwing for 340 yards in the Nov. 16 MNF game vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after right-thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots and is expected to miss the rest of 2026.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported to be out for the season. J.J. McCarthy is the Giants' starter.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Miami placed him on IR on Nov. 10 with a groin/core-muscle injury, so he will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is starting.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is Miami's starter while Malik Willis is on IR (placed Nov. 10, groin/core muscle) for at least four games.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) returned from a four-game absence on TNF Nov. 19 vs. the Colts and handled a workhorse load: 26 carries for 107 yards plus 3 catches for 17 yards. With Woody Marks (concussion) out, he was clearly Houston's lead back.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) sat out TNF Nov. 19 while David Montgomery returned and took 26 carries for 107 yards. Even after Marks clears protocol, he looks like Montgomery's backup.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: McGowan played on TNF Nov. 19 at Houston even though he had been listed out, but his offensive role shrank to 3 carries for 7 yards and 1 catch, with most of his work coming on 3 kick returns for 117 yards. That is a sharp drop from his 12-carry Week 10.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) missed practice again Wednesday, Nov. 18, which leaves his status for Nov. 22 vs. Arizona uncertain despite earlier reports that he was expected to play. Reid called it a sore groin that is improving and said the team won't rush him.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) missing practice again Nov. 18, Johnson may start a second straight game Nov. 22 vs. Arizona after his 171-yard, 2-TD breakout Nov. 15 at Atlanta.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Washington opened Croskey-Merritt's 21-day practice window this week, and he was cleared to resume practicing after landing on IR (groin) Oct. 19. He is a candidate to be activated for the Nov. 23 MNF game vs. Cincinnati barring a setback.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Rodriguez (hand) was a limited practice participant again Wednesday, Nov. 18, and remains questionable for Jacksonville's Week 11 game. He has played through the hand issue before.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Sleeper has listed Tuten questionable (ankle) since Nov. 18 ahead of Jacksonville's Week 11 game, and no practice update has been found yet. Friday's final designation will decide his availability.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: Sleeper listed James questionable (calf) as of Nov. 19 ahead of San Francisco's Week 11 game. No practice details have been found yet.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Green Bay is on its Week 11 bye. Ian Rapoport reported Nov. 17 that Jacobs (finger) has a realistic chance to return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Green Bay is on its Week 11 bye, and Josh Jacobs (finger) reportedly has a realistic chance to return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams (Rapoport, Nov. 17). That would likely end Johnson's run as the lead early-down back.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: In Week 10 (Nov. 15), Corum out-carried Kyren Williams 17-12 on an even 39-39 snap split and ran for 100 yards and a TD, which points to a growing committee role.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Williams had just 12 carries for 23 yards in Week 10 (Nov. 15) while Blake Corum out-carried him 17-12 on an even snap split, which signals a Rams committee.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Stevenson, playing through a knee issue, had 6 carries for 4 yards on 26 of 59 snaps Nov. 15 and was out-carried by Corey Kiner.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on IR on Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four games.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR as of Nov. 16. With Jonah Coleman established as Denver's lead back, Harvey's role is likely to shrink when he returns.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle) did not practice Wednesday, Nov 18, and is still listed as questionable for Sunday at Denver. Klint Kubiak called him day-to-day and said he could play without practicing, so he may be a game-time decision.

players.name: Michael Mayer
players.note: Mayer played 49 of 59 snaps in Week 10 after Bowers left. Bowers (ankle) is still questionable for Week 11 at Denver after a Nov 18 DNP, and Mayer would be a low-end starter if Bowers sits.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Hockenson (wrist/chest) was limited Wednesday, Nov 18, after missing Week 10, and remains questionable for Sunday vs. San Francisco in Mexico City. Kevin O'Connell is hopeful he returns, and Jordan Addison's thumb surgery could mean more targets for him.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (knee sprain) did not practice Nov 18 and is listed out for Week 11 vs. Tennessee. Brian Schottenheimer has said he will miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.note: Waller (knee) did not practice Wednesday, Nov 18, and Dave Canales called the injury a 'concern' ahead of Sunday vs. Baltimore. He is listed as questionable, and Tommy Tremble (knee) also sat out.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (thumb) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) did not practice Wednesday, Nov 18, and is listed as questionable for Week 11 vs. Miami. Dawson Knox would be next up if he is limited or out.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: The Chiefs placed TE Jared Wiley (ankle) on IR on Nov 18, which leaves Kelce with only Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool behind him. Kelce is off the injury report after playing just 20 snaps in Week 10.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Likely caught 9 of 11 targets for 127 yards and a TD on 57 of 65 snaps in Week 10 (Nov 15). That locks him in as the Giants' every-down TE1 for Week 11.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson remains on IR after Sean McVay said on Nov 14 that he would miss 'another couple weeks.' The Rams are on bye in Week 11.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Higbee played 51 of 76 snaps with a TD in Week 10 and stays the Rams' lead TE while Terrance Ferguson is on IR for a couple more weeks. The Rams are on bye in Week 11.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown hurt his hamstring Nov 15 vs. Detroit, and no imaging results or timeline had been reported as of Nov 20. New England is on its Week 11 bye, so Week 12 vs. the Chargers is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison had thumb surgery after a practice injury, but Kevin O'Connell said around Nov 17 that he will not go on IR because the team expects him back in fewer than four games. He is still out for Week 11.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) came off the injury report Nov 18 after missing two games. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, he is in line for more targets in Week 11.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: Burks started on TNF at Houston on Nov 19 but did not catch any of his 3 targets, per Sleeper stats; he also had one 10-yard kick return. That is two straight games without a catch despite the open Colts WR depth chart.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion) practiced fully Nov 18, and reports had him at full again Thursday, Nov 19. He is trending toward playing Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas, pending formal clearance from the protocol.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) was a full practice participant Thursday, Nov 19, and is off the injury report. He is set to return in Week 11 vs. Pittsburgh after missing three games.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) returned to practice as a limited participant Nov 18 after missing two games. The Titans hope he can play Sunday vs. Dallas; check Friday's designation.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell (knee) was limited in his return to practice this week (Nov 18-19) after being ruled out of Week 10. He is described as day-to-day ahead of Sunday vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas (shoulder) was limited and wore a non-contact jersey Nov 18, but he is reportedly on track to play Sunday vs. Buffalo. Chris Bell's return to practice threatens Douglas' expanded role.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Meyers was limited with an ankle injury Nov 18; he has played through the injury for several weeks. Jacksonville faces the Giants Sunday.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) has missed three straight games and did not practice Nov 18 ahead of the Chargers' Week 11 game vs. the Jets. A fourth straight absence looks likely.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel caught a TD in his Nov 15 return, playing 44 of 65 snaps. However, Mike Evans (Achilles) returned to practice as a limited participant Thursday, Nov 19, which could soon cut into Samuel's targets.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: With Elijah Sarratt a healthy scratch, Lane drew 11 targets Nov 16 vs. the Chargers and caught 3 for 61 yards. He is now ahead of Sarratt in Baltimore's rotation.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt sat out Nov 16 vs. the Chargers as a coach's decision while Ja'Kobi Lane took an 11-target role. His place in the rotation is now in question.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Allen played only 23 of 65 snaps Nov 15 in Josh Downs' Chiefs debut, though he caught a TD. Downs pushes him down the target pecking order.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk remains on reserve/left squad, and his reinstatement is reportedly delayed by a bonus-forfeiture dispute. No activation, trade or release had been reported as of Nov 18.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring, IR) is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce (heel) has been on IR since Week 3 and did not play TNF on Nov 19. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce will return in 2026.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: With Harrison out, Collins caught 3 of 5 targets for 58 yards and a 42-yard TD in the TNF game vs. the Colts on Nov 19. That is far fewer targets than the 16 he drew on Nov 15.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Even with Harrison out, Dell managed just 3-27 on 4 targets in the TNF game vs. the Colts on Nov 19, and Xavier Hutchinson started (2-13 on 3 targets). The expected bump in volume didn't show up.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) missed the TNF game vs. the Colts on Nov 19, his second straight absence. No practice timeline for Week 12 has been reported.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles) did not practice Nov 18 after missing three straight games, and Shanahan only 'hoped' he would practice Thursday. No Thursday upgrade had been reported as of early Nov 20, and he looks doubtful for Sunday vs. Minnesota in Mexico City.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Evans (Achilles) has not been reported back at practice this week, so Allen likely stays in the 49ers' WR rotation for Sunday vs. Minnesota after a 5-61 debut on Nov 15.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back) was limited Nov 18 after missing two games. No Thursday upgrade had been reported as of Nov 20, so he is a true game-time risk for Sunday vs. the Jets.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris went 5-86 on Nov 16 with McConkey out. McConkey (back) is practicing on a limited basis this week (Nov 18), which could shrink Harris's Week 11 role if McConkey plays.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Tyson (chest) was limited at practice Nov 18 after an 11-catch game on Nov 15. No Thursday status had been reported as of Nov 20 for Sunday vs. Chicago.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Cooper (ankle/hip) did not practice Nov 18 after aggravating the ankle Nov 15. No imaging result or Thursday practice status had been reported as of Nov 20, ahead of Sunday vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) is in his 21-day IR practice window, which opened Nov 18, and practice reports list him as limited. He has not been activated for Sunday at Philadelphia as of Nov 20.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (hand) is practicing fully in his IR return window, which opened Nov 18. McCarthy suggested he could be cleared for Sunday at Philadelphia, but no activation had been reported as of Nov 20.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Jordan Addison (thumb) did not practice Nov 18, and reports say he won't go on short-term IR but is expected to miss time. That keeps Jefferson in a heavy-volume WR1 role after 13 targets on Nov 15.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring, injured Nov 1) has missed two straight games, and no return timeline had been reported as of Nov 20. Atlanta is on bye in Week 11.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains, turf toe) has been on IR since Nov 12. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is reportedly his earliest return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR during New England's Week 11 bye, and no return date had been reported as of Nov 20.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle (announced Nov 9).

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill was still an unsigned free agent as of Nov 20, with no signing reported. In mid-November, agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill was a few weeks from medical clearance after his ACL tear, which points to December at the earliest.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 3:44 AM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Burden (concussion, Nov 8) is still listed questionable on Sleeper after Chicago's Week 10 bye; he must clear the protocol before Week 11.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:34 PM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Monangai (toe) has been upgraded to questionable on Sleeper (Nov. 18) after Chicago's Week 10 bye. D'Andre Swift remains the lead back.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 3:44 AM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Singleton was a healthy scratch (coach's decision) on Nov. 15 vs. Jacksonville, while Tony Pollard (8 catches, 1 TD) and Tyjae Spears both played.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 3:44 AM PT Nov 18.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 12:32 PM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Randall remains on IR after not playing Nov. 16 vs. the Chargers. His practice window opened in late October, so an activation decision is due soon.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 3:44 AM PT Nov 18.
